Gholm operates Sifel. Sifel routes to relay Ruzel. Ruzel controls device Prava. Prava produces frost.
Nydra operates Tormu. Tormu routes to relay Trimm. Trimm controls device Quist. Quist produces grit.
Ashvi operates Vlask. Vlask routes to relay Wonda. Wonda controls device Ryvok. Ryvok produces haze.
Fendor operates Zenna. Zenna routes to relay Xalor. Xalor controls device Skerv. Skerv produces ion.
Wexla operates Ektar. Ektar routes to relay Yibbo. Yibbo controls device Tolvo. Tolvo produces jolt.
Xyphor operates Pyx. Pyx routes to relay Zaffi. Zaffi controls device Urska. Urska produces mist.
Brunev operates Wroll. Wroll routes to relay Angth. Angth controls device Vikra. Vikra produces note.
Thalex operates Aumsa. Aumsa routes to relay Blokt. Blokt controls device Wexu. Wexu produces pulse.
Iovar operates Chesk. Chesk routes to relay Criva. Criva controls device Xorn. Xorn produces rime.
Zundi operates Ondri. Ondri routes to relay Duvra. Duvra controls device Zaph. Zaph produces shade.
